description: common/mod.rs Inner uses HashMap<(String, String), ...> for objects, states, and change_log. Every lookup (current_state, objects_ref, objects_mut) calls type_name.to_owned() and account_id.to_owned() to construct the key. This is two String allocations per lookup. In a test harness that does hundreds of operations, this adds up. The standard idiom is to implement Borrow<(str, str)> for a key type (via a wrapper) or use a two-level HashMap<String, HashMap<String, ...>>. Since this is test-only code the impact is limited, but it's a missed teaching example for backend implementors.
title: MemoryBackend: (String, String) HashMap keys allocate on every lookup
